Abi-Dalzim's Horrid Wilting.components: V, S, M (a bit of sponge)
Abi-Dalzim's Horrid Wilting.description: You draw the water out of every creature in a 30-foot cube. Each makes a Constitution save, taking 12d8 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Plants and water elementals save with disadvantage and take maximum damage. Nonmagical plants in the area that aren't creatures wither and die.

Absorb Elements.casting_time: 1 reaction, when you take acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage
Absorb Elements.description: You catch some of the incoming energy. You have resistance to that damage type against the triggering hit and until the start of your next turn. The first time you hit with a melee attack on your next turn, it deals an extra 1d6 damage of that type.
Absorb Elements.more: The extra melee damage rises by 1d6 for each level above 1st.

Aganazzar's Scorcher.components: V, S, M (a red dragon's scale)
Aganazzar's Scorcher.description: A 30-foot line of roaring flame, 5 feet wide, runs from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d8 fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
Aganazzar's Scorcher.more: Damage rises by 1d8 for each level above 2nd.

Air Bubble.description: A bubble of fresh air surrounds the head of up to one willing creature you can see (more with more mana). It can breathe normally in water or in airless space for the duration.
Air Bubble.more: One more creature for each level above 2nd.

Antagonize.components: V, S, M (a playing card bearing a rival's face)
Antagonize.description: You whisper something cutting to a creature you can see. It makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it takes 4d4 psychic damage and must immediately use its reaction to make a melee attack against another creature of your choice that you can see; if it can't, it has disadvantage on its next attack before the end of its next turn. On a success it takes half damage only.
Antagonize.more: Damage rises by 1d4 for each level above 3rd.

Arcane Gate.description: You open two linked portals, each a 10-foot circle: one on the ground within 10 feet of you, one within range. Anything stepping into one comes out of the other. Each portal has a front, which you choose; only the front works. On your turn you can rotate the rings as a bonus action.

Arcane Vigor.description: You tap your own life force: spend up to two of your Hit Dice and regain hit points equal to the roll plus your spellcasting modifier.
Arcane Vigor.more: You can spend one more Hit Die for each level above 2nd.

Armor of Agathys.components: V, S, M (a cup of water)
Armor of Agathys.description: A frost-skinned ward covers you. You gain 5 temporary hit points. While they last, any creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 5 cold damage.
Armor of Agathys.more: Both the temporary hit points and the cold damage rise by 5 for each level above 1st.

Arms of Hadar.description: Dark tendrils burst out of you. Each creature within 10 feet makes a Strength save. On a failure it takes 2d6 necrotic damage and can't take reactions until its next turn. On a success it takes half damage only.
Arms of Hadar.more: Damage rises by 1d6 for each level above 1st.

Ashardalon's Stride.description: Flames trail your steps. Your speed rises by 20 feet, moving doesn't provoke opportunity attacks, and each creature or object you first move within 5 feet of on a turn takes 1d6 fire damage.
Ashardalon's Stride.more: Speed rises by 5 more feet and fire by 1d6 for each level above 3rd.

Aura of Purity.description: A purifying aura surrounds you. Friendly creatures in it (you too) can't become diseased, resist poison damage, and have advantage on saves against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned or stunned.

Aura of Vitality.description: Healing energy radiates from you. As a bonus action on each of your turns, you can heal one creature in the aura (you included) for 2d6 hit points.

Banishing Smite.description: The next time you hit with a weapon attack before the spell ends, the strike deals an extra 5d10 force damage. If that leaves the target at 50 hit points or fewer, you banish it to a harmless pocket plane until the spell ends (or for good, if it's not from this plane and you keep concentration for the full minute).

Beast Bond.components: V, S, M (a bit of fur wrapped in cloth)
Beast Bond.description: You link minds with a friendly beast with an Intelligence of 3 or less. You can share simple thoughts and feelings, and while it can see you it has advantage on attacks against creatures within 5 feet of you.

Beast Sense.description: You touch a willing beast and use its senses: you see and hear what it does, blind and deaf to your own surroundings until you switch back as an action.

Blade of Disaster.description: You tear open a blade-shaped rift in reality. When it appears, and as a bonus action on later turns, you can move it up to 30 feet and make up to two melee spell attacks with it against creatures within 5 feet of it. Each hit deals 4d12 force damage, and it scores a critical hit on a 18 or higher, dealing 12d12 extra force damage. It passes through barriers, even a Wall of Force.

Blade Ward.description: You trace a ward in the air. Until the end of your next turn you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from weapon attacks.

Blinding Smite.description: Your next weapon hit before the spell ends blazes with light: an extra 3d8 radiant damage, and the target must make a Constitution save or be blinded until the spell ends. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

Bones of the Earth.description: Up to six pillars of stone, each 5 feet across and up to 30 feet tall, burst from the ground at points you choose. A creature on top of one makes a Dexterity save or is lifted with it; one caught between a pillar and a ceiling takes 6d6 bludgeoning and is restrained. Pillars have AC 5 and 30 hit points.
Bones of the Earth.more: Two more pillars for each level above 6th.

Booming Blade.description: Make a melee weapon attack as part of the spell. On a hit the target suffers the weapon's normal effects and is sheathed in booming energy: if it willingly moves before your next turn, it takes 1d8 thunder damage and the spell ends. Damage grows at 5th level (1d8 on the hit plus 2d8 if it moves), 11th and 17th.

Borrowed Knowledge.components: V, S, M (a book worth 25 gp)
Borrowed Knowledge.description: You draw on the knowledge of those who studied before you. Pick one skill you lack; you have proficiency in it for the hour. The spell ends early if you cast it again.

Branding Smite.description: Your next weapon hit before the spell ends brands the target with light: an extra 2d6 radiant damage, and if it was invisible it becomes visible and sheds dim light, and can't turn invisible until the spell ends.
Branding Smite.more: Extra damage rises by 1d6 for each level above 2nd.

Catapult.description: An object weighing 1 to 5 pounds within range flies up to 90 feet in a straight line. A creature in its path makes a Dexterity save or takes 3d8 bludgeoning damage, and the object stops. The object takes the same damage when it hits something.
Catapult.more: Damage rises by 1d8, and the weight limit by 5 pounds, for each level above 1st.

Catnap.description: Up to three willing creatures fall into a magical sleep for the duration. A sleeper wakes early if harmed or shaken awake. A creature that sleeps the full 10 minutes gets the benefit of a short rest, and can't benefit from this spell again until it finishes a long rest.
Catnap.more: One more creature for each level above 3rd.

Cause Fear.description: You wake a creature's sense of doom. It makes a Wisdom save or is frightened of you until the spell ends, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Constructs and undead are immune.
Cause Fear.more: One more creature for each level above 1st, all within 30 feet of each other.

Ceremony.components: V, S, M (25 gp of powdered silver, consumed)
Ceremony.description: You lead one religious rite: Atonement (an Insight check lets a repentant creature return to its old alignment), Bless Water, Coming of Age (a d4 bonus to one check for 24 hours), Dedication (a d4 bonus to one save for 24 hours), Funeral Rite (the corpse can't become undead for 7 days), Wedding (couples get +2 AC while fighting side by side for 7 days).

Chaos Bolt.description: Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit the target takes 2d8 + 1d6 damage; the d8s decide the damage type (acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, poison, psychic, thunder). If both d8s show the same number, the bolt leaps to another creature within 30 feet, and can keep leaping.
Chaos Bolt.more: Each target takes 1d6 more damage for each level above 1st.

Circle of Power.description: Divine energy shields you and nearby allies. Friendly creatures in the aura have advantage on saves against spells and magical effects, and when they succeed on a save that would deal half damage, they take none.

Cloud of Daggers.components: V, S, M (a sliver of glass)
Cloud of Daggers.description: Spinning daggers fill a 5-foot cube. A creature takes 4d4 slashing damage when it enters the cube for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there.
Cloud of Daggers.more: Damage rises by 2d4 for each level above 2nd.

Compelled Duel.description: You challenge a creature you can see. It makes a Wisdom save or has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you, and must save again to move more than 30 feet away from you. The spell ends if you attack someone else, an ally attacks it, or you move more than 30 feet from it.

Conjure Barrage.components: V, S, M (one piece of ammunition or a thrown weapon)
Conjure Barrage.description: You throw or fire one weapon and it multiplies into a hail of copies. Each creature in a 60-foot cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d8 damage of the weapon's type on a failure or half on a success.

Conjure Volley.components: V, S, M (one piece of ammunition or a thrown weapon)
Conjure Volley.description: You fire one shot into the air and it becomes a rain of thousands. Each creature in a 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-tall cylinder makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d8 damage of the weapon's type on a failure or half on a success.

Control Flames.description: You shape a nonmagical fire no bigger than a 5-foot cube: spread it 5 feet, put it out, make it twice as bright or dim, or shape simple figures in it for an hour. Up to three non-instant effects at once.

Control Winds.description: You take charge of the air in a 100-foot cube and choose one effect, changeable each turn as an action: Gusts (strong wind in one direction, making flying and ranged attacks harder), Downdraft (flyers make a Strength save or are pushed down; fliers land), or Updraft (a rising wind that slows falls and helps jumps).

Cordon of Arrows.components: V, S, M (four or more arrows or bolts)
Cordon of Arrows.description: You plant four pieces of ammunition in the ground. Whenever a creature other than those you name comes within 30 feet of them for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, one flies up at it: it makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 piercing damage. The spell ends when the ammunition runs out.
Cordon of Arrows.more: Two more pieces of ammunition for each level above 2nd.

Create Bonfire.description: A bonfire springs up in a 5-foot square on the ground. A creature in it when it appears, or that enters it or ends its turn there, makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d8 fire damage. It lights flammable objects. Damage grows to 2d8 at 5th level, 3d8 at 11th and 4d8 at 17th.

Create Homunculus.components: V, S, M (clay, ash and mandrake root, and a jewel-encrusted dagger worth 1,000 gp)
Create Homunculus.description: You cut yourself with the dagger, taking 2d4 piercing damage that can't be reduced, and your blood brings the components to life as a homunculus: a tiny, loyal construct. You share a telepathic link with it, and while you're on the same plane you can see and hear through it. You can have only one at a time.

Create Magen.components: V, S, M (a vial of quicksilver worth 500 gp and a life-sized doll, both consumed, plus an intricate crystal rod worth 1,500 gp that isn't)
Create Magen.description: You make a magen: an artificial person who obeys you. Choose the type: demos (a soldier), galvan (it flies and fires lightning) or hypnos (it bends minds). It serves until destroyed. Your hit point maximum drops by the magen's challenge rating × 10 while it exists.

Create Spelljamming Helm.components: V, S, M (a crystal rod worth 5,000 gp, consumed)
Create Spelljamming Helm.description: You turn a Large or smaller chair you touch into a spelljamming helm. A creature with the ability to cast spells who sits in it can move a ship through the air and the void. (In Avarenth, the DM decides whether such magic even works here.)

Crown of Madness.description: A twisted crown of jagged iron appears on a humanoid you can see. It makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you: before moving on each of its turns, it must make a melee attack against a creature of your choice that you can see. You must use your action each turn to keep control or the spell ends. It repeats the save at the end of each turn.

Crown of Stars.description: Seven star-like motes orbit your head. As a bonus action you can fling one at a creature within 120 feet: a ranged spell attack dealing 4d12 radiant damage. While four or more remain, they shed bright light.
Crown of Stars.more: Two more motes for each level above 7th.

Crusader's Mantle.description: Holy power radiates from you. Each friendly creature in the aura (you too) deals an extra 1d4 radiant damage when it hits with a weapon attack.

Danse Macabre.description: Up to five Small or Medium corpses within range rise as zombies or skeletons under your control. You can command them all as a bonus action. They add your spellcasting modifier to attack and damage rolls. They collapse when the spell ends.
Danse Macabre.more: Two more corpses for each level above 5th.

Dark Star.components: V, S, M (a shard of onyx and a drop of the caster's blood)
Dark Star.description: A 40-foot-radius sphere of crushing darkness and silence forms at a point you choose. It is difficult terrain, nothing can see or hear into or out of it, and a creature that enters or starts its turn there makes a Constitution save, taking 8d10 force damage on a failure or half on a success. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by it is crushed to nothing.

Dawn.components: V, S, M (a sunburst pendant worth 100 gp)
Dawn.description: A 30-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder of sunlight shines at a point you choose. Each creature in it when it appears makes a Constitution save, taking 4d10 radiant damage on a failure or half on a success; it saves again whenever it ends its turn there. You can move the cylinder up to 60 feet as a bonus action.

Destructive Wave.description: You strike the ground and divine energy rolls out. Each creature you choose within 30 feet makes a Constitution save. On a failure it takes 5d6 thunder plus 5d6 radiant or necrotic damage (your choice) and is knocked prone. On a success it takes half and stays standing.

Distort Value.description: You make an object up to a 1-foot cube look worth twice as much, or half as much, as it really is. A creature examining it can see through the illusion with an Investigation check against your spell save DC.
Distort Value.more: The object can be 1 foot larger on each side for each level above 1st.

Draconic Transformation.components: V, M (a statuette of a dragon worth 500 gp)
Draconic Transformation.description: You take on draconic traits: blindsight 30 feet, spectral wings that give you a flying speed of 60 feet, and a breath of shimmering energy you can exhale when you cast it and as a bonus action on later turns: a 60-foot cone, Dexterity save, 6d8 force damage, half on a success.

Dream of the Blue Veil.components: V, S, M (a magic item or willing creature from the destination world)
Dream of the Blue Veil.description: You and up to eight willing creatures fall into a dream of another world (one you know of, through an item or creature from there). At the end of the dream you all appear there, physically, in a place linked to the item or creature. The DM decides where that world even is.

Druid Grove.description: You awaken the spirits of an area up to a 90-foot cube of nature to guard it. Choose from: solid fog, grasping undergrowth, grove guardians (animated trees), an additional spell effect (gust of wind, spike growth, etc.), or difficult terrain. The grove knows friends from foes as you say. Cast it in the same place every day for a year and it becomes permanent.

Dust Devil.components: V, S, M (a pinch of dust)
Dust Devil.description: A 5-foot-cube whirlwind forms. Each creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of it makes a Strength save, taking 1d8 bludgeoning damage and being pushed 10 feet away on a failure, or half damage only on a success. You can move it 30 feet as a bonus action; over sand or dust it blinds things in a 10-foot cloud.
Dust Devil.more: Damage rises by 1d8 for each level above 2nd.

Earth Tremor.description: You make the ground shake. Each creature other than you within 10 feet makes a Dexterity save, taking 1d6 bludgeoning damage and falling prone on a failure. Loose earth or stone in the area becomes difficult terrain.
Earth Tremor.more: Damage rises by 1d6 for each level above 1st.

Earthbind.description: Yellow strips of magic bind a flying creature you can see. It makes a Strength save or its flying speed becomes 0; if it's in the air it drifts down 60 feet a round until it lands.

Elemental Bane.description: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder. A creature you can see makes a Constitution save or, for the duration, takes an extra 2d6 damage of that type the first time each turn it's hit by it, and loses any resistance to it.
Elemental Bane.more: One more creature for each level above 4th.

Elemental Weapon.description: A nonmagical weapon becomes magical: +1 to attack rolls and an extra 1d4 damage of a type you choose (acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder).
Elemental Weapon.more: +2 and 2d4 at 5th or 6th level; +3 and 3d4 at 7th and up.

Encode Thoughts.description: You pull a memory, idea or message out of your head and shape it into a thread of thought that can be held. Another creature with this spell can read it, or you can use it as the dream-link for some magic. It fades after 8 hours.

Enemies Abound.description: You fill a creature's mind with suspicion. It makes an Intelligence save or loses the ability to tell friend from foe: every creature it can see is an enemy to it, and when it attacks it picks its target at random among those in reach. It repeats the save each time it takes damage.

Enervation.description: A tendril of darkness latches onto a creature. It makes a Dexterity save. On a success it takes 2d8 necrotic damage and the spell ends. On a failure it takes 4d8 now and again on each of your turns as an action, and you regain half the necrotic damage as hit points. Constructs and undead aren't affected.
Enervation.more: Damage rises by 1d8 for each level above 5th.

Erupting Earth.components: V, S, M (a piece of obsidian)
Erupting Earth.description: The ground at a point erupts. Each creature in a 20-foot cube makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d12 bludgeoning damage on a failure or half on a success. The ground there becomes difficult terrain until cleared.
Erupting Earth.more: Damage rises by 1d12 for each level above 3rd.

Far Step.description: You teleport up to 60 feet to a space you can see, and can do so again as a bonus action on each turn until the spell ends.

Fast Friends.description: A humanoid you can see makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you and will do reasonable tasks you ask, as long as they aren't dangerous or against its nature. If you or your friends harm it, the spell ends.
Fast Friends.more: One more humanoid for each level above 3rd.

Feeblemind.components: V, S, M (a handful of clay, crystal, glass or mineral spheres)
Feeblemind.description: You blast a creature's mind. It takes 4d6 psychic damage and makes an Intelligence save. On a failure its Intelligence and Charisma scores drop to 1: it can't cast spells, use magic items, understand language or talk sensibly, though it knows its friends. It repeats the save every 30 days. Greater Restoration, Heal or Wish ends it. (The SRD's Befuddlement is the newer, lighter version.)

Feign Death.components: V, S, M (a pinch of graveyard dirt)
Feign Death.description: You put a willing creature into a deathlike state. It looks dead to any inspection, is blinded and incapacitated, its speed drops to 0, it resists all damage but psychic, and disease and poison in it are paused. You can end it early.

Festering Blast.description: A blast of rot bursts at a point. Creatures in it take necrotic damage, and wounds fester: they can't heal properly for a while.

Find Greater Steed.description: You summon a loyal, intelligent spirit in the form of a griffon, pegasus, peryton, dire wolf, rhinoceros or saber-toothed tiger. It serves as your mount, can speak telepathically with you, and when you cast a spell targeting only yourself you can have it affect the steed too. Only one such steed at a time.

Fizban's Platinum Shield.components: V, S, M (a platinum-plated dragon scale worth 500 gp)
Fizban's Platinum Shield.description: A field of silvery light surrounds one creature: half cover, resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning and poison damage, and evasion-like protection against Dexterity saves for half damage. As a bonus action on later turns, you can move the shield to another creature within 60 feet.

Flame Arrows.description: You touch a quiver of up to twelve arrows or bolts. Each one fired deals an extra 1d6 fire damage, then the magic leaves it.
Flame Arrows.more: Two more pieces of ammunition for each level above 3rd.

Flock of Familiars.description: You summon three spirits that take familiar forms of your choice, as if from Find Familiar. They obey you and can deliver touch spells. You share senses with one at a time.
Flock of Familiars.more: One more familiar for each level above 2nd.

Fortune's Favor.components: V, M (a white pearl worth 100 gp, consumed)
Fortune's Favor.description: You give a willing creature a glimpse of the future. Once during the hour it can roll an extra d20 for an attack, check or save, or when it's attacked, and choose which d20 to use.
Fortune's Favor.more: One more creature for each level above 2nd.

Fount of Moonlight.description: Cool moonlight wraps you and sheds light in 20 feet. You have resistance to radiant damage, your melee attacks deal an extra 2d6 radiant, and when a creature within 60 feet hits you, you can use your reaction to force it to make a Constitution save or be blinded until the end of your next turn.

Fractured Awareness.description: Your mind splits into several. You can do extra things each turn (like a second bonus action or reaction), and you can't be surprised.

Friends.components: S, M (a small amount of makeup)
Friends.description: You have advantage on Charisma checks against one non-hostile creature for the duration. When it ends, the creature knows you used magic on it and may well turn hostile.

Frost Fingers.description: Freezing cold pours from your fingertips. Each creature in a 15-foot cone makes a Constitution save, taking 2d8 cold damage on a failure or half on a success. Water in the cone freezes to a depth of 1 inch.
Frost Fingers.more: Damage rises by 1d8 for each level above 1st.

Frostbite.description: Frost forms on a creature you can see. It makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 cold damage and has disadvantage on its next weapon attack before the end of its next turn. Damage grows to 2d6 at 5th level, 3d6 at 11th and 4d6 at 17th.

Galder's Speedy Courier.components: V, S, M (25 gold pieces, consumed)
Galder's Speedy Courier.description: You summon a small air elemental beside a chest that opens for the duration. Put whatever fits inside, name a creature you've met on this plane, and when the spell ends the elemental carries the chest's contents straight to that creature (or back, if it can't be found).
Galder's Speedy Courier.more: The duration rises with more mana: 1 hour at 5th, 8 hours at 6th, 24 hours at 7th level.

Galder's Tower.components: V, S, M (a fragment of stone, wood or other building material)
Galder's Tower.description: You conjure a two-story tower of stone, wood or similar material on open ground. Each floor is a 10-foot square room with a door, stairs and a window. It has furnishings and is lit. Creatures inside can see out but the outside is opaque. It vanishes when the spell ends.
Galder's Tower.more: One more story for each level above 3rd.

Gate Seal.components: V, S, M (a broken portal key, consumed)
Gate Seal.description: You seal a 30-foot cube against planar travel. No portal or gate in it can be used, and nothing can teleport or plane shift in or out of it.
Gate Seal.more: Cast with the 60 mana of a 6th-level spell or more, the seal lasts until dispelled.

Gift of Alacrity.description: You touch a willing creature and give it a feel for the flow of time. For the duration it adds 1d8 to its initiative rolls.

Gift of Gab.components: V, S, M (2 gold pieces, consumed)
Gift of Gab.description: When you say something you regret, you take it back: every creature within 15 feet that heard what you said in the last 6 seconds forgets it, and you can say something else in its place. They remember only the new version.

Grasping Vine.description: A vine sprouts from the ground at a point you can see. When you cast it, and as a bonus action on later turns, the vine lashes at a creature within 30 feet of it: a Dexterity save or be pulled 20 feet toward the vine.

Grave Ground.description: The ground in an area turns to grave soil. Hands of the dead clutch at creatures (slowing or restraining them), and necrotic energy drains those standing in it.

Gravity Fissure.components: V, S, M (a fistful of iron filings)
Gravity Fissure.description: You open a 100-foot line, 5 feet wide, of crushing gravity. Each creature in it makes a Constitution save, taking 8d8 force damage on a failure or half on a success. Each creature within 10 feet of the line but not in it makes the save too or is pulled toward the line.
Gravity Fissure.more: Damage rises by 1d8 for each level above 6th.

Gravity Sinkhole.description: A 20-foot-radius sphere of crushing force forms at a point. Each creature in it makes a Constitution save, taking 5d10 force damage on a failure or half on a success, and those that fail are pulled toward the center.
Gravity Sinkhole.more: Damage rises by 1d10 for each level above 4th.

Green-Flame Blade.description: Make a melee weapon attack as part of the spell. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon's normal effects, and green fire leaps to a second creature within 5 feet of it, dealing fire damage equal to your spellcasting modifier. The damage grows at 5th, 11th and 17th level (extra fire on the first target and more on the leap).

Guardian of Nature.description: A nature spirit transforms you. Primal Beast: +10 speed, darkvision 120, advantage on Strength attacks, and 1d6 extra force damage on melee weapon hits. Great Tree: 10 temporary hit points, advantage on Constitution saves and on Dexterity and Wisdom attacks, and the ground near you becomes difficult terrain for your enemies.

Gust.description: You seize the air: push a Medium or smaller creature 5 feet (Strength save), push an object up to 5 pounds 10 feet, or make a harmless sensory effect like rustling leaves or slamming shutters.

Hail of Thorns.description: The next time you hit with a ranged weapon attack before the spell ends, your ammunition explodes into thorns. The target and each creature within 5 feet of it make a Dexterity save, taking 1d10 piercing damage on a failure or half on a success.
Hail of Thorns.more: Damage rises by 1d10 for each level above 1st.

Healing Spirit.description: A nature spirit fills a 5-foot cube. When you or a creature you can see moves into it for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, you can have it heal that creature for 1d6. It can heal a number of times equal to 1 + your spellcasting modifier. You can move it 30 feet as a bonus action.
Healing Spirit.more: Healing rises by 1d6 for each level above 2nd.

Hindsight.description: You see the past of the place where you stand: events that happened there, years or centuries ago, play out before your eyes.

Holy Star of Mystra.description: A glowing star hovers near you. It sheds light, shields you from spells (some it turns back on their caster), and you can fire bolts of radiant energy from it.

Holy Weapon.description: A weapon you touch glows with holy light (bright light in 30 feet). Attacks with it deal an extra 2d8 radiant damage. As a bonus action, the wielder can end the spell in a burst: each creature of their choice within 30 feet makes a Constitution save, taking 4d8 radiant damage and being blinded for a minute on a failure, or half damage only on a success.

Homunculus Servant.components: V, S, M (a gem or crystal)
Homunculus Servant.description: You build a homunculus: a tiny construct that serves you, fights alongside you, and can deliver your touch spells. It lasts until destroyed.

Hunger of Hadar.components: V, S, M (a pickled octopus tentacle)
Hunger of Hadar.description: You open a gateway to the dark between the stars: a 20-foot-radius sphere of blackness and bitter cold. Nothing can see inside it, and it is difficult terrain. A creature starting its turn there takes 2d6 cold damage; one ending its turn there makes a Dexterity save or takes 2d6 acid damage as unseen things lick at it.

Illusory Dragon.description: A Huge shadowy dragon appears. When it appears, each creature you choose that can see it makes a Wisdom save or is frightened for a minute. As a bonus action you can move it 60 feet and have it breathe a 60-foot cone: Intelligence save, 7d6 damage of a type you choose (acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic or poison), half on a success. It can't be harmed and an Investigation check reveals it as an illusion.

Immolation.description: Flames wreathe a creature you can see. It makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success. On a failure it keeps burning, taking 4d6 fire at the end of each of its turns and saving again to end it. It sheds light and can be put out by water. A creature killed by it turns to ash.

Immovable Object.components: V, S, M (gold dust worth 25 gp, consumed)
Immovable Object.description: You fix an object of 10 pounds or less in place. It can't move unless a creature succeeds on a Strength check against your DC (and you can name creatures who can move it freely). It can hold up to 4,000 pounds.
Immovable Object.more: At 4th or 5th level: the Strength DC to move it rises by 5, it holds 8,000 pounds, and it lasts 24 hours. At 6th or higher: DC +10, 20,000 pounds, and it lasts until dispelled.

Incite Greed.components: V, S, M (a gem worth at least 50 gp)
Incite Greed.description: You hold up the gem and its glitter calls to others. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet that can see you makes a Wisdom save or is charmed: it must move toward you on its turn and can't take actions other than moving or gawking until it's within 5 feet, and it can't move away.

Infernal Calling.components: V, S, M (a ruby worth 999 gp)
Infernal Calling.description: You call a devil of challenge rating 6 or lower from the Nine Hells. It isn't friendly to you; it does what you say only if it wants to, and you can bargain with it. If you know its true name or hold its talisman, it's easier to control. When the spell ends it goes home. (In Avarenth, devils are the DM's to place; this may reach your patron's enemies.)
Infernal Calling.more: The devil's challenge rating rises by 1 for each level above 5th.

Infestation.description: A cloud of mites, fleas and lice covers a creature. It makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 poison damage and moves 5 feet in a random direction (if it can). Damage grows to 2d6 at 5th level, 3d6 at 11th and 4d6 at 17th.

Inflict Doubt.description: You fill a creature's mind with second thoughts. It rolls a d4 and subtracts it from its attacks and saves, and it may lose its action hesitating.

Intellect Fortress.description: A shimmering mental barrier guards one creature. It has resistance to psychic damage and advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves.
Intellect Fortress.more: One more creature for each level above 3rd, all within 30 feet of each other.

Investiture of Flame.description: Flames race across your body. You shed light, are immune to fire, resist cold, and creatures that move within 5 feet of you or hit you in melee take 1d10 fire damage. As an action, you can blast a 15-foot line of fire: Dexterity save, 4d8 fire, half on a success.

Investiture of Ice.description: Ice rimes your body. You are immune to cold, resist fire, move across ice easily, and the ground within 10 feet of you is difficult terrain for others. As an action, you can blast a 15-foot cone of freezing wind: Constitution save, 4d6 cold and slowed, half and no slow on a success.

Investiture of Stone.description: Rocky plates cover your body. You resist nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage. As an action, you can make the ground in a 15-foot radius shake: each other creature there makes a Dexterity save or falls prone. You can move through stone and earth as if it were difficult terrain.

Investiture of Wind.description: Wind whirls around you. Ranged weapon attacks against you have disadvantage, and you gain a flying speed of 60 feet. As an action, you can create a 15-foot cube of swirling wind within 60 feet: Constitution save, 2d10 bludgeoning, half on a success, and a Large or smaller creature that fails is pushed 10 feet.

Invulnerability.components: V, S, M (a small piece of adamantine worth 500 gp, consumed)
Invulnerability.description: You are immune to all damage until the spell ends. Nothing gets through, so you can stand at the front of a fight without flinching at what hits you.
Invulnerability.more: The adamantine is consumed in the casting, so this is a last-ditch spell for the worst moment of a battle.

Iron Body.components: V, S, M (a piece of iron)
Iron Body.description: Your body turns to living iron. You resist most damage and are immune to poison and many conditions, your fists hit like hammers, but you're slow, heavy and sink in water.

Jallarzi's Storm of Radiance.components: V, S, M (a pinch of phosphorus)
Jallarzi's Storm of Radiance.description: Radiant hail and thunder fill a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder. Inside, creatures are blinded and deafened, and can't cast spells with verbal components. A creature that enters it for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Constitution save, taking 2d10 radiant and 2d10 thunder damage on a failure or half on a success.
Jallarzi's Storm of Radiance.more: Each damage type rises by 1d10 for each level above 5th.

Jim's Glowing Coin.description: You throw a coin and it starts glowing and making noise. Each creature of your choice within 60 feet that can see it makes a Wisdom save or is distracted: it has disadvantage on Perception checks and initiative rolls until the spell ends. Disturbing the coin ends the spell.

Jim's Magic Missile.description: Three glowing darts fly at creatures you choose. Unlike Magic Missile, each needs a ranged spell attack, dealing 2d4 force on a hit. On a natural 1 they all miss and hit you for 1 damage each; on a natural 20 each deals 5d4.
Jim's Magic Missile.more: One more dart for each level above 1st.

Kinetic Jaunt.description: You magically empower your movement. Your walking speed rises by 10 feet, moving doesn't provoke opportunity attacks, and you can move through other creatures' spaces (as difficult terrain). You can't end your turn in another creature's space.

Laeral's Silver Lance.description: You hurl a lance of silver light that strikes one creature for heavy radiant or force damage and can pierce through to one behind it.

Life Transference.description: You sacrifice your own life to mend another. You take 4d8 necrotic damage, which can't be reduced, and a creature you can see heals twice that much.
Life Transference.more: Damage (and healing) rise by 1d8 for each level above 3rd.

Lightning Arrow.description: The next time you make a ranged weapon attack, your ammunition becomes a bolt of lightning. Make the attack as normal: the target takes 4d8 lightning damage on a hit or half on a miss, instead of the weapon's damage. Then each creature within 10 feet of the target makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d8 lightning damage, half on a success.
Lightning Arrow.more: Both damages rise by 1d8 for each level above 3rd.

Lightning Lure.description: A lash of lightning strikes a creature within 15 feet. It makes a Strength save or is pulled up to 10 feet toward you, then takes 1d8 lightning damage if it's within 5 feet of you. Damage grows to 2d8 at 5th level, 3d8 at 11th and 4d8 at 17th.

Lightning Ring.description: A ring of crackling lightning spins around you. Creatures that come near are shocked, and each turn you can fling bolts of lightning from it.

Linked Glyphs.components: V, S, M (powdered diamond worth 200 gp, consumed)
Linked Glyphs.description: You draw two linked glyphs, which must be on the same plane. When the first is triggered, the second unleashes its stored spell or effect where it is, so a trap on one side of a dungeon can go off on the other. Works like Glyph of Warding.

Maddening Darkness.components: V, M (a drop of pitch mixed with a drop of mercury)
Maddening Darkness.description: Magical darkness fills a 60-foot-radius sphere. Not even darkvision sees through it; nonmagical light can't light it. Shrieks and laughter fill it. A creature starting its turn there makes a Wisdom save, taking 8d8 psychic damage on a failure or half on a success.

Maelstrom.components: V, S, M (paper or leaf in the shape of a funnel)
Maelstrom.description: A swirling 30-foot-radius, 5-foot-deep pool of water appears on the ground. It's difficult terrain, and a creature starting its turn there makes a Strength save or takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage and is pulled 10 feet toward the center.

Magic Stone.description: You touch up to three pebbles and fill them with magic. A creature can throw one or sling it, making a ranged spell attack with your spellcasting modifier for 1d6 + that modifier bludgeoning damage.

Magnify Gravity.components: V, S, M (a small iron ball)
Magnify Gravity.description: Gravity in a 10-foot-radius sphere grows heavy. Each creature there makes a Constitution save, taking 2d8 force damage on a failure (or half on a success), and on a failure its speed is halved until the end of its next turn. Objects there get harder to lift.
Magnify Gravity.more: Damage rises by 1d8 for each level above 1st.

Mass Polymorph.description: Like Polymorph, but up to ten creatures. Each unwilling creature makes a Wisdom save. Each one you change becomes a beast of challenge rating no higher than its own (or half its level), keeping its hit points as a buffer.

Maximilian's Earthen Grasp.components: V, S, M (a miniature hand sculpted from clay)
Maximilian's Earthen Grasp.description: A Medium hand of compacted earth rises in a 5-foot square. When it appears, and as an action on later turns, it reaches for a creature within 5 feet of it: a Strength save or take 2d6 bludgeoning damage and be restrained. You can crush a restrained creature for 2d6 as an action, or move the hand 30 feet.

Melf's Minute Meteors.components: V, S, M (niter, sulfur and pine tar formed into a bead)
Melf's Minute Meteors.description: Six tiny meteors orbit you. As a bonus action you can send one or two at points within 120 feet; each explodes, and each creature within 5 feet makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
Melf's Minute Meteors.more: Two more meteors for each level above 3rd.

Mental Prison.description: You trap a creature in an illusion it can't escape. It takes 5d10 psychic damage on a failed Intelligence save (half on a success, and the spell ends). On a failure it sees itself surrounded by danger: if it moves out, or reaches through the illusion, it takes 10d10 psychic damage and the spell ends.

Mighty Fortress.components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 500 gp, consumed)
Mighty Fortress.description: A stone fortress rises from the ground: a 120-foot-square keep with four towers, walls, a courtyard and furnished rooms. A hundred spectral servants attend it. It lasts 7 days, then crumbles; cast it in the same place every 7 days for a year and it's permanent.

Mind Sliver.description: You drive a spike of psychic energy into a creature. It makes an Intelligence save or takes 1d6 psychic damage and subtracts 1d4 from the next save it makes before the end of your next turn. Damage grows to 2d6 at 5th level, 3d6 at 11th and 4d6 at 17th.

Mold Earth.description: You shape dirt or sand in a 5-foot cube: dig it out and drop it within 5 feet, carve shapes or colors into it for an hour, or turn it into difficult terrain (or back) for an hour.

Moment of Prescience.description: You glimpse the next moment. Once before the spell ends, you can add a large bonus to one attack, check or save, or to your AC against one attack.

Mordenkainen's Lucubration.description: You recall a spell you've cast today and regain it: get back the mana of a spell up to 5th level that you cast since your last long rest.

Motivational Speech.description: Up to five creatures who listen to your speech gain 5 temporary hit points and advantage on Wisdom saves for the duration. When one is hit by an attack, it has advantage on the next attack roll it makes. When a creature loses all its temporary hit points, the spell ends for it.
Motivational Speech.more: Temporary hit points rise by 5 for each level above 3rd.

Nathair's Mischief.components: S, M (a piece of crust from an apple pie)
Nathair's Mischief.description: Fey mischief fills a 20-foot cube. At the start of each of your turns, roll a d4: charmed (Wisdom save or charmed by you), blinded (Wisdom save or blinded), dazzled (difficult terrain and disadvantage on concentration), or spraying (sweet-smelling sprite dust that makes creatures fall prone on a Dex save).

Negative Energy Flood.components: V, M (a broken bone and a square of black silk)
Negative Energy Flood.description: You send dark energy at a creature you can see. If it's undead, it gains 5d12 temporary hit points. Otherwise it makes a Constitution save, taking 5d12 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success; if that kills it, it rises as a zombie at the start of your next turn and attacks the nearest creature.

Power Word Fortify.description: You speak a word of strength and share out 120 temporary hit points as you choose among up to six creatures you can see.

Power Word Pain.description: A word of power wracks a creature with 100 hit points or fewer. Its speed drops to 10 feet, it has disadvantage on attacks, checks and saves (except Constitution), and to cast a spell it must pass a Constitution save. It repeats a Constitution save at the end of each of its turns. Creatures immune to charm aren't affected.

Primal Savagery.description: Your teeth or nails grow sharp. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet, dealing 1d10 acid damage on a hit. Damage grows to 2d10 at 5th level, 3d10 at 11th and 4d10 at 17th.

Primordial Ward.description: You have resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning and thunder damage. When you take damage of one of those types, you can use your reaction to gain immunity to it instead, ending the spell at the end of your next turn.

Psychic Scream.description: You unleash the power of your mind on up to ten creatures with Intelligence 3 or higher. Each makes an Intelligence save, taking 14d6 psychic damage and being stunned on a failure, or half and no stun on a success. A creature killed by it has its head explode. Stunned creatures repeat the save each turn.

Pulse Wave.description: A wave of force rolls out in a 30-foot cone. Each creature there makes a Constitution save, taking 6d6 force damage on a failure or half on a success. On a failure you can pull or push it up to 15 feet.
Pulse Wave.more: Damage rises by 1d6, and the push by 5 feet, for each level above 3rd.

Pyrotechnics.description: Pick a nonmagical flame you can see. It goes out, and becomes either fireworks (each creature within 10 feet makes a Constitution save or is blinded until the end of your next turn) or thick smoke (a 20-foot cloud that blocks sight for a minute).

Raulothim's Psychic Lance.description: A shimmering lance of psychic power leaps at a creature you can see, or one you name (if it's within range, even behind cover). It makes an Intelligence save, taking 7d6 psychic damage and becoming incapacitated until your next turn on a failure, or half damage only on a success.
Raulothim's Psychic Lance.more: Damage rises by 1d6 for each level above 4th.

Ravenous Void.components: V, S, M (a small, nine-pointed star made of iron)
Ravenous Void.description: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of destructive gravity. It's difficult terrain, and creatures within 100 feet of it are pulled 20 feet toward it each turn (Strength save). A creature that starts its turn inside is restrained, takes 5d10 force damage and has its items pulled away; one reduced to 0 hit points is torn to nothing.

Reality Break.description: You shatter a creature's grip on reality. It makes a Wisdom save or can't take reactions, and at the start of each of its turns it rolls a d10: 1–2, visions of the void stun it until its turn ends and it takes 6d12 psychic damage; 3–5, a rift tears at it (Dexterity save or 8d12 force); 6–8, it's flung up to 30 feet through a wormhole, taking 10d12 force and falling prone; 9–10, the cold between worlds takes 10d12 cold damage and blinds it until its turn ends. It makes a Wisdom save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.

Reweave Fate.casting_time: 1 reaction, when a creature you can see rolls a d20
Reweave Fate.description: You pull at the threads of fate and change an outcome: a hit becomes a miss, a failure a success (or the other way round).

Rime's Binding Ice.description: A burst of cold erupts from you in a 30-foot cone. Each creature there makes a Constitution save, taking 3d8 cold damage on a failure or half on a success. Those that fail are encased in ice: their speed is 0 until they or someone else breaks the ice (an action, AC 10, 15 hit points).
Rime's Binding Ice.more: Damage rises by 1d8 for each level above 2nd.

Sapping Sting.description: You sap the vitality of a creature you can see. It makes a Constitution save or takes 1d4 necrotic damage and falls prone. Damage grows to 2d4 at 5th level, 3d4 at 11th and 4d4 at 17th.

Scatter.description: The air quivers around up to five creatures of your choice that you can see. An unwilling one makes a Wisdom save to resist. Each affected creature teleports to an unoccupied space you choose within 120 feet of you, on the ground or on a floor.

Shadow Blade.description: You weave a sword of solid shadow in your hand. It's a simple melee weapon you're proficient with: 2d8 psychic damage, finesse, light and thrown (20/60). If you attack with it from dim light or darkness you have advantage. Drop or throw it and it vanishes, but you can call it back to your hand as a bonus action.
Shadow Blade.more: Damage becomes 3d8 at 3rd or 4th level, 4d8 at 5th or 6th, and 5d8 at 7th or higher.

Shadow of Moil.components: V, S, M (an undead eyeball encased in a gem worth 150 gp)
Shadow of Moil.description: Flame-like shadows wreathe you. You're heavily obscured to others, you resist radiant damage, and any creature within 10 feet that hits you takes 2d8 necrotic damage.

Shape Water.description: You control water in a 5-foot cube: move it or change its flow, shape it into simple forms that move as you wish for an hour, change its color or opacity for an hour, or freeze it (if there are no creatures in it) for an hour.

Sickening Radiance.description: Dim, greenish light fills a 30-foot-radius sphere. A creature in it at the start of its turn makes a Constitution save, taking 4d10 radiant damage and a level of exhaustion on a failure, and glows (no hiding, no invisibility). Exhaustion from this spell fades when the spell ends.

Silvery Barbs.casting_time: 1 reaction, when a creature you can see succeeds on an attack, check or save
Silvery Barbs.description: You throw silvery words that unsettle the creature: it rerolls the d20 and must use the lower roll. Then a different creature of your choice within 60 feet has advantage on its next attack, check or save in the next minute.

Skill Empowerment.description: You touch a willing creature and choose a skill it's proficient in: it gets expertise (double proficiency) in that skill for the duration.

Skywrite.description: You write up to ten words in clouds anywhere in the sky you can see. A strong wind can blow them away early.

Snare.components: S, M (25 feet of rope, consumed)
Snare.description: You set a magical trap on a 5-foot circle on the ground. It's nearly invisible (Intelligence (Investigation) against your DC to spot). A Small or larger creature that steps in makes a Dexterity save or is restrained and hoisted upside down 3 feet in the air. It can try again on each of its turns, or others can free it.

Snilloc's Snowball Swarm.components: V, S, M (a piece of ice or small white rock)
Snilloc's Snowball Swarm.description: A flurry of snowballs bursts at a point you choose. Each creature in a 5-foot-radius sphere makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d6 cold damage on a failure or half on a success.
Snilloc's Snowball Swarm.more: Damage rises by 1d6 for each level above 2nd.

Soul Cage.casting_time: 1 reaction, when a humanoid you can see within 60 feet dies
Soul Cage.components: V, S, M (a tiny silver cage worth 100 gp)
Soul Cage.description: You snatch the soul of a creature as it dies and trap it in the cage. Until the spell ends you can use it, each use once: steal its life (heal 2d8), query it (one question, honest-ish answer), borrow its experience (advantage on one roll), or eyes of the dead (scry a place it saw in life). The soul is freed when the spell ends. (In Avarenth, gods notice such things.)

Spellfire Flare.description: A flare of raw, silver-gold spellfire bursts at a creature, dealing radiant damage. (Spellfire is raw magic itself.)

Spellfire Storm.description: A storm of raw spellfire crashes over an area, dealing heavy radiant damage to everything in it and disrupting magic there.

Spirit Lantern.description: Your lantern burns with ghost-light. It reveals invisible and ethereal things, protects you from spirits, and can draw out or harm undead.

Spirit of Death.components: V, S, M (a gilded playing card worth 400 gp depicting an avatar of death)
Spirit of Death.description: You call up a reaper spirit that obeys you. It hovers, fights on your turn, and its scythe deals necrotic damage that gets stronger with the spell's level. When it reduces a creature to 0 hit points, that creature can't be healed or brought back until the spell ends.
Spirit of Death.more: The spirit grows stronger (more hit points and damage) for each level above 4th.

Spirit Shroud.description: Spirits of the dead flit around you. When you hit a creature within 10 feet, it takes an extra 1d8 radiant, necrotic or cold damage (your choice), and it can't regain hit points until the start of your next turn. You can also slow one creature within 10 feet by 10 feet each turn.
Spirit Shroud.more: Extra damage rises by 1d8 for every two levels above 3rd.

Spray of Cards.components: V, S, M (a deck of cards)
Spray of Cards.description: Razor-sharp spectral cards spray out in a 15-foot cone. Each creature there makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d10 force damage and being blinded until the end of its next turn on a failure, or half damage only on a success.
Spray of Cards.more: Damage rises by 1d10 for each level above 2nd.

Staggering Smite.description: Your next melee weapon hit before the spell ends rattles the target's mind: an extra 4d6 psychic damage, and it makes a Wisdom save or has disadvantage on attacks and checks and can't take reactions until the end of its next turn.

Steel Wind Strike.components: S, M (a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp)
Steel Wind Strike.description: You flourish your weapon and vanish, striking at up to five creatures you can see within range. Make a melee spell attack against each: 6d10 force damage on a hit. Then you can teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of one of them.

Storm Sphere.description: A 20-foot-radius sphere of whirling air forms. It's difficult terrain, and a creature ending its turn there makes a Strength save or takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage. As a bonus action on later turns, you can make a lightning bolt leap from the sphere's center at a creature within 60 feet: a ranged spell attack for 4d6 lightning (with advantage if the target is inside).
Storm Sphere.more: Both damages rise by 1d6 for each level above 4th.

Summon Aberration.components: V, S, M (a pickled tentacle and an eyeball in a platinum-inlaid vial worth 400 gp)
Summon Aberration.description: You call an aberrant spirit: beholderkin (flying, eye ray), slaad (claws, regeneration) or star spawn (psychic slam, whispering aura). It obeys you, acts on your turn, and its numbers (AC, hit points, attacks) scale with the spell's level.
Summon Aberration.more: The spirit grows stronger for each level above 4th: more hit points, better AC and damage.

Summon Beast.components: V, S, M (a feather, tuft of fur and fish tail inside a gilded acorn worth 200 gp)
Summon Beast.description: You call a bestial spirit: air (flies, flyby), land (climbs, pack tactics) or water (swims, breathes water). It obeys you, acts on your turn, and its numbers scale with the spell's level.
Summon Beast.more: The spirit grows stronger for each level above 2nd.

Summon Celestial.components: V, S, M (a golden reliquary worth 500 gp)
Summon Celestial.description: You call a celestial spirit: an avenger (a ranged radiant bow) or a defender (a radiant mace and protective shield). It can also heal once. It obeys you, acts on your turn, and its numbers scale with the spell's level.
Summon Celestial.more: The spirit grows stronger for each level above 5th.

Summon Construct.components: V, S, M (an ornate stone and metal lockbox worth 400 gp)
Summon Construct.description: You call the spirit of a construct: clay (absorbs damage), metal (heated body burns attackers) or stone (slows nearby foes). It obeys you, acts on your turn, and its numbers scale with the spell's level.
Summon Construct.more: The spirit grows stronger for each level above 4th.

Summon Dinosaur.description: You call a primal spirit in the shape of a dinosaur (a charging, biting beast). It obeys you, acts on your turn, and grows stronger with more mana.

Summon Draconic Spirit.components: V, S, M (an object with the image of a dragon engraved on it, worth 500 gp)
Summon Draconic Spirit.description: You call a draconic spirit (chromatic, gem or metallic). It flies, bites, breathes a cone of its element, and you share its resistance while you're within 10 feet of it. It obeys you, acts on your turn, and its numbers scale with the spell's level.
Summon Draconic Spirit.more: The spirit grows stronger for each level above 5th.

Summon Elemental.components: V, S, M (air, a pebble, ash and water inside a gold-inlaid vial worth 400 gp)
Summon Elemental.description: You call an elemental spirit: air (flies), earth (burrows), fire (ignites what it hits) or water (grapples). It obeys you, acts on your turn, and its numbers scale with the spell's level.
Summon Elemental.more: The spirit grows stronger for each level above 4th.

Summon Fey.components: V, S, M (a gilded flower worth 300 gp)
Summon Fey.description: You call a fey spirit in a mood: fuming (advantage on its next attack), mirthful (charms) or tricksy (darkness). It teleports a short distance each turn, obeys you, and its numbers scale with the spell's level.
Summon Fey.more: The spirit grows stronger for each level above 3rd.

Summon Fiend.components: V, S, M (humanoid blood inside a ruby vial worth 600 gp)
Summon Fiend.description: You call a fiendish spirit: demon (bites, explodes in fire when slain), devil (hurls flame) or yugoloth (claws and teleport). It obeys you, acts on your turn, and its numbers scale with the spell's level. (In Avarenth, this is demon-touched magic; expect consequences.)
Summon Fiend.more: The spirit grows stronger for each level above 6th.

Summon Greater Demon.components: V, S, M (a vial of blood from a humanoid killed in the past 24 hours)
Summon Greater Demon.description: You call a demon of challenge rating 5 or lower. It rolls initiative and acts on its own turn, attacking the nearest non-demon. Each turn you command it, it makes a Charisma save; on a success it breaks free and does as it likes. Draw a blood circle first and it can't leave. (In Avarenth: very much demon business.)
Summon Greater Demon.more: The demon's challenge rating rises by 1 for each level above 4th.

Summon Lesser Demons.components: V, S, M (a vial of blood from a humanoid killed in the past 24 hours)
Summon Lesser Demons.description: Roll on a table to call a group of minor demons (several manes, dretches or similar). They're hostile to everyone, attacking the nearest non-demon each turn, though a blood circle keeps them in. (In Avarenth: demon business.)
Summon Lesser Demons.more: More demons appear at 6th and 8th level.

Summon Plant.description: You call a plant spirit (a grasping vine creature or tree-like guardian). It obeys you, holds and strikes enemies, and grows stronger with more mana.

Summon Shadowspawn.components: V, S, M (tears inside a crystal vial worth 300 gp)
Summon Shadowspawn.description: You call a shadowy spirit: fury (advantage when frightening), despair (slows nearby foes) or fear (frightens and hides in dim light). It obeys you, acts on your turn, and its numbers scale with the spell's level.
Summon Shadowspawn.more: The spirit grows stronger for each level above 3rd.

Summon Undead.components: V, S, M (a gilded skull worth 300 gp)
Summon Undead.description: You call an undead spirit: ghostly (flies through walls, frightens), putrid (poisons nearby, paralyzes) or skeletal (ranged grave bolts). It obeys you, acts on your turn, and its numbers scale with the spell's level.
Summon Undead.more: The spirit grows stronger for each level above 3rd.

Swift Quiver.components: V, S, M (a quiver containing at least one piece of ammunition)
Swift Quiver.description: Your quiver produces an endless supply of nonmagical ammunition. As a bonus action on each of your turns, you can make two attacks with a weapon that uses it.

Sword Burst.description: Spectral blades sweep around you. Each creature within 5 feet makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 force damage. Damage grows to 2d6 at 5th level, 3d6 at 11th and 4d6 at 17th.

Syluné's Viper.description: A silvery serpent of magic coils around you. It strikes at creatures that attack you, and can bite with poison or warn you of danger.

Synaptic Static.description: A psychic burst erupts at a point. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere makes an Intelligence save, taking 8d6 psychic damage on a failure or half on a success. Those that fail are muddled for a minute: they subtract 1d6 from attacks, checks and concentration saves, repeating the save at the end of each turn.

Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron.components: V, S, M (a gilded ladle worth 500 gp)
Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron.description: A claw-footed cauldron appears, filled with a potion of your choice of common or uncommon rarity that you've seen (DM approves). You can draw out a number of bottles equal to your spellcasting modifier; they vanish when you finish your next long rest if unused.

Tasha's Caustic Brew.components: V, S, M (a bit of rotten food)
Tasha's Caustic Brew.description: A 30-foot line of acid sprays from you. Each creature in it makes a Dexterity save or is covered in acid, taking 2d4 acid damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can use its action to scrape it off.
Tasha's Caustic Brew.more: Damage rises by 2d4 for each level above 1st.

Tasha's Mind Whip.description: You lash a creature's mind. It makes an Intelligence save. On a failure it takes 3d6 psychic damage, can't take reactions until its next turn ends, and on that turn can take only one of: move, action or bonus action. On a success it takes half damage only.
Tasha's Mind Whip.more: One more creature for each level above 2nd.

Tasha's Otherworldly Guise.components: V, S, M (an object engraved with a symbol of the Outer Planes, worth 500 gp)
Tasha's Otherworldly Guise.description: You take on the aspect of the Lower or Upper Planes: immunity to fire and poison (lower) or radiant and necrotic (upper), immunity to being poisoned or charmed, spectral wings (flying 40 feet), +2 AC, magical weapon attacks, two attacks when you take the Attack action, and you can use your spellcasting ability for weapon attacks.

Telepathy.components: V, S, M (a pair of linked silver rings)
Telepathy.description: You create a telepathic link with a willing creature you know, on the same plane. You can share words, images, sounds and other sensory messages with each other for the duration.

Temple of the Gods.components: V, S, M (a holy symbol worth at least 5 gp)
Temple of the Gods.description: A temple to your god rises from the ground: up to 120 feet on a side, 120 feet tall. Creatures of a type you name (or all who aren't your faith) have to pass a Charisma save to enter. Inside, divination and attempts to charm are hampered, and healing spells heal extra. Cast it in the same place every day for a year and it's permanent.

Temporal Shunt.casting_time: 1 reaction, when a creature you see makes an attack or casts a spell
Temporal Shunt.description: You shunt a creature through time. It makes a Wisdom save or vanishes, and the attack or spell is wasted. It reappears at the start of its next turn, in the space it left (or nearest).
Temporal Shunt.more: One more creature for each level above 5th.

Tenser's Transformation.components: V, S, M (a few hairs from a bull)
Tenser's Transformation.description: You become a fighting machine: 50 temporary hit points, advantage on weapon attacks, an extra 2d12 force damage on weapon hits, proficiency with all armor, shields, simple and martial weapons, and Strength and Constitution saves, and two attacks when you take the Attack action. You can't cast spells. When it ends, you make a Constitution save or gain a level of exhaustion.

Tether Essence.components: V, S, M (a spool of platinum cord worth 250 gp, consumed)
Tether Essence.description: Two creatures you can see within 30 feet of each other make Constitution saves (with disadvantage if close). If both fail, they're tethered: damage one takes, the other takes too, and healing one heals the other. If one drops to 0 hit points, the other does too.

Thorn Whip.components: V, S, M (the stem of a plant with thorns)
Thorn Whip.description: A long, thorny vine whips at a creature in range. Make a melee spell attack: 1d6 piercing damage, and a Large or smaller creature is pulled up to 10 feet toward you. Damage grows to 2d6 at 5th level, 3d6 at 11th and 4d6 at 17th.

Thunder Step.description: You teleport to a space you can see within range, leaving a thunderclap behind. Each creature within 10 feet of where you left makes a Constitution save, taking 3d10 thunder damage on a failure or half on a success. You can bring one willing creature within 5 feet with you.
Thunder Step.more: Damage rises by 1d10 for each level above 3rd.

Thunderclap.description: A burst of thunder bangs out from you. Each creature other than you within 5 feet makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 thunder damage. It can be heard 100 feet away. Damage grows to 2d6 at 5th level, 3d6 at 11th and 4d6 at 17th.

Thunderous Smite.description: Your next melee weapon hit before the spell ends rings with thunder heard 300 feet away: an extra 2d6 thunder damage, and the target makes a Strength save or is pushed 10 feet and knocked prone.

Tidal Wave.components: V, S, M (a drop of water)
Tidal Wave.description: A wave of water 30 feet long, 10 feet wide and 10 feet tall crashes down at a point. Each creature in it makes a Dexterity save, taking 4d8 bludgeoning damage and falling prone on a failure, or half and staying up on a success. The water spreads out and puts out fires.

Time Ravage.components: V, S, M (an hourglass filled with diamond dust worth 5,000 gp, consumed)
Time Ravage.description: You age a creature you can see. It makes a Constitution save, taking 10d12 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. If it fails, it also ages to the brink of death: disadvantage on attacks, checks and saves, and its speed is halved. Only Wish or Greater Restoration cast with a 9th-level spell undoes it. Most creatures die of old age within 30 days.

Tiny Servant.description: You bring a Tiny nonmagical object to life: it sprouts little arms and legs and becomes a creature that obeys you. It can carry small loads, scout, fetch things and fight weakly.
Tiny Servant.more: Two more objects for each level above 3rd.

Toll the Dead.description: You point at a creature and the sound of a dolorous bell fills the air. It makes a Wisdom save or takes 1d8 necrotic damage, or 1d12 if it's already missing any hit points. Damage grows at 5th, 11th and 17th level.

Transfix.description: You lock a creature in place. It makes a Wisdom save or is paralyzed, frozen in mid-motion, repeating the save each turn.

Transmute Rock.description: Choose an area of stone or mud up to a 40-foot cube. Turn rock to mud (difficult terrain, creatures can sink and be restrained, and things above may fall) or mud to rock (creatures in it make a Dexterity save or are trapped in stone and restrained until they break free).

Uncertain Footing.description: The ground in an area becomes slick and shifting. It's difficult terrain, and creatures moving in it may fall prone.

Vision of Elapsing Eons.description: You show creatures the passing of ages. They see centuries go by in moments: they take psychic damage, age, or are stunned by the vision.

Vortex Warp.description: You twist space around a creature you can see. It makes a Constitution save (or chooses to fail) or teleports to an unoccupied space you can see within range.
Vortex Warp.more: The teleport range grows by 30 feet for each level above 2nd.

Wail of the Banshee.description: You let out a terrible wail. Each creature of your choice that hears it makes a Constitution save or drops to 0 hit points; those that succeed take heavy psychic damage instead.

Wall of Light.description: A shimmering wall of light, up to 60 feet long, 10 feet high and 5 feet thick, appears. It blocks sight, sheds bright light, and creatures in it when it appears make a Constitution save, taking 4d8 radiant damage and being blinded for a minute on a failure, or half damage only on a success. As an action you can fire a beam from it at a creature within 60 feet (a ranged spell attack, 4d8 radiant), shrinking the wall by 10 feet.
Wall of Light.more: Damage rises by 1d8 for each level above 5th.

Wall of Sand.components: V, S, M (a handful of sand)
Wall of Sand.description: A wall of swirling sand, up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high and 10 feet thick, appears. It blocks sight, and a creature moving through it is blinded inside and moves at a third of its speed.

Wall of Water.components: V, S, M (a drop of water)
Wall of Water.description: A wall of water, up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high and 1 foot thick (or a ring 20 feet across), appears. It's difficult terrain, ranged weapon attacks through it have disadvantage, fire damage through it is halved, and cold damage can freeze sections solid.

Wardaway.casting_time: 1 reaction, when you or an ally near you is attacked
Wardaway.description: A quick ward pushes away an attack: the target gets a bonus to AC against it, and the attacker may be pushed back.

Warding Wind.description: A strong wind (20 mph) blows around you in a 10-foot radius. It deafens you and others in it, puts out small flames, hedges out vapor and gas, makes the area difficult terrain for others, and gives ranged weapon attacks into or out of it disadvantage.

Warp Sense.description: You sense the folds of space. You learn where portals, gates and planar thin spots are near you, and roughly where they lead.

Watery Sphere.components: V, S, M (a droplet of water)
Watery Sphere.description: A 5-foot-radius sphere of water forms. Up to four Medium or smaller creatures in it make a Strength save or are restrained inside. As an action you can move the sphere 30 feet; restrained creatures move with it. A creature can try to escape at the end of each of its turns.

Waves of Exhaustion.description: A wave of weariness rolls out from you. Creatures in the cone make a Constitution save or gain levels of exhaustion.

Whirlwind.description: A whirlwind 10 feet across and 30 feet tall howls down at a point. Each creature it touches makes a Dexterity save, taking 10d6 bludgeoning damage on a failure or half on a success. A Large or smaller creature that fails is pulled in and restrained, then flung out later. You can move it 30 feet as an action.

Witch Bolt.components: V, S, M (a twig from a tree struck by lightning)
Witch Bolt.description: A crackling beam of blue energy lances at a creature. Make a ranged spell attack: 1d12 lightning damage on a hit. On each of your turns you can use your action to deal 1d12 lightning to it automatically. The spell ends if it gets out of range or behind total cover.
Witch Bolt.more: The first hit deals 1d12 more for each level above 1st.

Wither and Bloom.components: V, S, M (a withered vine twisted into a loop)
Wither and Bloom.description: You call the decay and growth of nature at a point. Each creature you choose in a 10-foot-radius sphere makes a Constitution save, taking 2d6 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Nonmagical plants there wither. Then one creature of your choice in the area can spend and roll one of its Hit Dice and heal that much plus your spellcasting modifier.
Wither and Bloom.more: Damage rises by 1d6, and the healed creature can spend one more Hit Die, for each level above 2nd.

Word of Radiance.description: You speak a divine word and burning light erupts. Each creature of your choice within 5 feet makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 radiant damage. Damage grows to 2d6 at 5th level, 3d6 at 11th and 4d6 at 17th.

Wrath of Nature.description: You call the spirits of nature against your foes in a 60-foot cube. Trees lash enemies (Dexterity save or 4d6 slashing), grass and undergrowth become difficult terrain for them, roots and vines restrain (Strength save), and as a bonus action rocks fly at a creature for 3d8 bludgeoning and can knock it prone.

Wrathful Smite.description: Your next melee weapon hit before the spell ends deals an extra 1d6 psychic damage, and the target makes a Wisdom save or is frightened of you until the spell ends. As an action it can make a Wisdom check against your DC to steel itself and end the spell.

Wristpocket.description: You send an object you're holding (5 pounds or less) to a pocket dimension. As a bonus action you can bring it back to your hand, or send it away again. When the spell ends, the object returns to your hand.

Yolande's Regal Presence.description: You surround yourself with unearthly majesty. Each creature of your choice in the emanation when you cast it, or that enters it or ends its turn there, makes a Wisdom save, taking 4d6 psychic damage and being knocked prone or pushed 10 feet away on a failure, or half damage only on a success. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

Zephyr Strike.description: You move like the wind. Your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. Once before the spell ends, you can give yourself advantage on one weapon attack; if it hits, it deals an extra 1d8 force damage, and your speed rises by 30 feet until the end of that turn.

Zone of Amicability.description: You make an area feel calm and friendly. Creatures in it find it hard to start a fight: they must make a Charisma save to attack anyone there.

Alustriel's Mooncloak.description: A cloak of silver moonlight wraps you. It sheds dim light, lets you glide through the air, and blunts harm: you resist damage, and allies who shelter near you are harder to hit.
Alustriel's Mooncloak.more: Lasts longer or covers more allies.

Aura of Evasion.description: An aura of quickness surrounds you. You and allies in it take no damage from area effects when they succeed on a Dexterity save, and only half when they fail.

Backlash.casting_time: 1 reaction, when a spell targets you
Backlash.description: You turn some of a spell's power back on its caster. You take less from it, and the caster takes force damage as the magic snaps back.

Battle Familiar.description: You fill your familiar or companion with fighting spirit: it grows tougher, hits harder and can fight beside you instead of just helping.

Cacophonic Shield.description: A ring of clashing noise surrounds you. Creatures inside are deafened and can't be targeted by sound or speech-based effects from outside it, and enemies entering it take thunder damage.

Conjure Constructs.description: Small clockwork constructs spring up around you and swarm your enemies, dealing damage and getting in the way.

Death Armor.description: Shadowy armor of necrotic energy cloaks you for the hour. Creatures that hit you in melee take necrotic damage, and the cold of the grave clings to you while it lasts.

Deryan's Helpful Homunculi.description: Several tiny helpers appear and do small tasks for you: carry, fetch, hold, help with a check or distract an enemy.

Detonate.description: You make a creature or object explode from within. The target takes enormous force damage, and everything near it is caught in the blast.

Dirge.description: You sing a funeral song. Enemies near you lose strength and heart as you sing, taking psychic damage and penalties to their rolls each turn.

Disruptive Tune.casting_time: 1 reaction, when a creature you can see casts a spell
Disruptive Tune.description: A jarring note throws a caster off. It must pass a Constitution save or lose its concentration, or the spell fizzles.

Distorted Distance.description: You warp space in an area. Distances inside it stretch: moving through costs double, and ranged attacks across it are harder.

Doomtide.description: A tide of dark, dreadful mist rolls over an area. It blocks sight, and creatures caught in it are filled with dread and can't take reactions or think clearly.

Dueling Ground.description: You mark out a dueling ring with a creature. Others can't easily interfere, and fighting anyone outside it is harder for both of you.

Elminster's Effulgent Spheres.description: Glowing spheres orbit you. You can hurl them at foes for radiant damage, or spend one to absorb part of a spell aimed at you.

Elminster's Elusion.description: You step out of the way through space: you teleport a short distance, and the attack misses. The reaction is quick and takes no real effort, the step you take when a blow is already swinging toward you.

Entrancing Mirrors.description: Mirrors of light spring up around a group of creatures. Those that look in them are entranced by their reflections and stand still until harmed.

Simbul's Synostodweomer.description: You turn spell power into healing: the next spell you cast this turn heals you or a creature you touch instead of its normal effect, healing more for higher-level spells.

Songal's Elemental Suffusion.description: Elemental energy fills you. You resist acid, cold, fire, lightning and thunder, can fly a short way, and can lash out with bursts of elemental damage.
